service: fetch declared syndication sources and offer immutable claim-state bundles
admission: ActivityStreams Offer<ServiceSolicitation> addressed to the provider, followed by Accept<ServiceContract> carrying the exact provider offer
preconditions: the demand names one or more wires with admitted syndication adapter configurations
the customer accepts the zero-price offer and its exact demand digest
postconditions: the provider returns bundle values and canonical digests from its own exchange store
the provider never writes the customer's corpus
the customer independently validates and admits or refuses every returned bundle
